changes: Introduces a major application-wide UI/UX overhaul focused on alignment, readability, visual hierarchy, and intuitive navigation while preserving the proven v3.5.52 runtime architecture.
Reorganizes the sidebar into Browse, Library, and System sections with clearer active-location states, higher-contrast library counters, and improved navigation accessibility.

Standardizes typography, spacing, control sizing, borders, semantic status colors, focus treatment, panels, dialogs, Settings, Providers, Diagnostics, Discover, Automation, and Downloads for a more consistent desktop experience.
Improves Discover detail presentation with a seamless full-width backdrop and corrected title-header transition.

Reworks Automation library cards and item settings so poster metadata, monitoring labels, profile/root controls, Library Name, and Manage actions stay aligned across varied titles and content lengths.
Corrects Newsgroups All/Bookmarks/Recent tab structure so full labels and count badges remain readable without overlap or truncation across supported desktop widths.
Aligns the top-right Providers, Settings, and About controls with real icon-and-label content and responsive compact behavior.
regression_guards: v3.5.52 Authoritative Service Runtime Handoff remains preserved.
v3.5.51 BOM-safe provider loading remains preserved.
v3.5.49 Smooth Post-Processing Motion remains preserved.
v3.5.47 Session 0 SAB Launch Fix remains preserved.

Private SAB queue/history, Smart Import, Automation, Discover metadata behavior, tray/service logic, and Metadata Server v0.3.3 compatibility remain unchanged except for version identifiers and accepted UI presentation.
name: UI/UX Overhaul
